questions.question: How many days of annual paid leave do employees get?
questions.reference: Full-time employees accrue 22 days of annual paid leave.

questions.question: What is the price of the Pro plan per user per month?
questions.reference: The Pro plan costs $29 per user per month.

questions.question: How long is the self-serve refund window after a purchase?
questions.reference: Self-serve refunds are available for 30 days after the purchase date.

questions.question: What additional features does the Business plan include compared to Pro?
questions.reference: Business includes everything in Pro, plus unlimited projects, single sign-on (SSO), priority support, and audit logs.

questions.question: How long is a password reset link valid?
questions.reference: Password reset links expire after 24 hours.

questions.question: How many consecutive weeks can an employee work abroad without manager approval?
questions.reference: Working abroad for more than 4 consecutive weeks requires manager approval.

questions.question: How many document pages can the Pro plan process per month through the API?
questions.reference: The Pro plan processes up to 10,000 document pages per month through the API.
